description: Contrast prompt pairs for persona-vector extraction. phi_prior prompts elicit the base Phi-3.5-mini instruct prior (generic AI assistant responses). lumi_voice prompts elicit the desired Lumi persona. All prompts are distinct from the 41-prompt eval_identity.py holdout.
